summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Annaba Travel PWA. All major features working correctly including bilingual support, winter mode, navigation, bot functionality, and responsive design. Minor issue with Leaflet map markers visibility needs verification.

integration_issues.issue: Leaflet map markers not clearly visible during testing

design_issues.issue: Made with Emergent badge overlay blocks some click interactions
